what: The definition at the end of the Anthropic chain, read clause by clause against Impagliazzo–Paturi (2001). A READING, not a decision: no kernel decides that a formal definition is the textbook one. Read on 2026-11-05 from complexitylib's abstracts/ComplexityAbstracts/SubexponentialSATAbstract.lean at 7c66eb71 (the commit claimbox pins); the facts under `checked` were checked here by machine, the `rows` are read.

So no file of the port enters the statement.

rows.standard: s₃ > 0: some δ > 0 admits no O(2^{δn}) algorithm for 3-SAT

rows.lean: for every δ, some e, c and one machine, all fixed before the inputs; they may depend on δ
cslib's deterministic binary multitape TM: finitely many states, a fixed number of work tapes, a read-only input tape; time counts transitions
KSAT 3: satisfiable formulas whose clauses have at most 3 literals
numVars: the distinct variables occurring, not the largest label
c · 2^{δn} · (L+1)^e + c, with L the encoded length
rows.reading: to confirm: formulas may repeat clauses, so L is not bounded by a polynomial in n and the factor in L is needed; the usual convention, for the definition's authors to confirm

rows.lean: binary labels with explicit framing; the length proved exactly (length_encCNF: one bit per clause plus 10 + 8·b bits per literal, b the label's binary length)
some space bound must exist; otherwise unconstrained
no condition, not even on time
